1: Models & Core AI (frontier, open-weight, small/local, multimodal, reasoning, voice/image/music/video generation, memory/retrieval, training, inference efficiency, model evaluation).
2: Agents, Products & Applications (browser and computer-use agents, coding agents, enterprise agents, consumer assistants, creative apps, productivity, finance, legal, education, search, sales and marketing, workflow automation).
AI products, apps, agents and their launches or updates
3: Developer Tools, Open Source & Data (GitHub releases, SDKs and APIs, agent frameworks, inference and serving, RAG and vector DBs, local AI, CLI and IDE tools, datasets, model cards, plugins and integrations, benchmarks as developer products, data tooling and observability).
4: Research, Benchmarks & AI for Science (research methods, capability and safety benchmarks, evaluation science, AI for biology, chemistry and materials, climate and earth science, physics and mathematics, lab automation, scientific datasets, reproducibility).
5: Industry Voices & Quotes. The statement itself is the news: a notable person (CEO, founder, researcher, investor, official) says, predicts, warns, denies or clarifies something about AI. Subcategories: breaking statement; strategic viewpoint; technical insight; market or economic view; policy or governance statement; forecast; contrarian or disputed claim; correction, denial or clarification.
6: Companies, Startups, Funding & Deals (funding rounds, acquisitions, partnerships, IPO plans, executive changes, talent moves, reorganizations, failures and shutdowns, customer wins, commercial adoption).
7: Markets, Stocks & AI Economics (earnings and guidance, previews, filings, analyst changes, valuations, private credit and debt, capex, pricing, margins, productivity and ROI, demand and supply). Note: 26 Sep 2026 is a Saturday and 27 Sep a Sunday, so expect weekend analysis rather than trading-day news.
8: Chips, Hardware & Compute (GPUs, CPUs and ASICs, foundries, HBM and memory, packaging, lithography and equipment, servers and systems, networking and optics, storage, edge hardware, AI PCs and devices).
9: Data Centers, Energy & Infrastructure (construction, cloud and neoclouds, grid and electricity, nuclear and gas, cooling and water, land and permitting, financing and leases, fiber, transformers, local opposition and community impact).
10: Healthcare & Biotech (clinical AI, medical imaging, diagnostics, hospital and care operations, digital health, pharmaceuticals, drug discovery, genomics and precision medicine, medical devices, clinical validation and regulation).
11: Robotics, Autonomy & Physical AI (humanoids, industrial robots, service robots, autonomous vehicles, drones, manipulation and locomotion, embodied perception and navigation, warehouse and logistics robotics, edge autonomy, wearables and smart devices).
12: Cybersecurity, Safety, Reliability & Data Governance (AI-assisted attack and defense, vulnerabilities and incidents, agent security, model safety and alignment, privacy, identity and provenance, data governance, evaluations and red teaming, operational reliability).
13: Policy, Law, Geopolitics, Defense & Sovereign AI (regulation and standards, courts and liability, copyright and IP, antitrust, elections and information integrity, export controls and trade, defense and national security, sovereign AI, public procurement, geopolitical competition).
14: Society, Work, Media, Education & Culture (jobs and labor, education and learning, journalism and media, entertainment, creators and culture, accessibility, inequality, public services, ethics and philosophy, consumer and community impact).
15: Quantum & Advanced Computing (quantum hardware, algorithms, software, communications and networking, sensing, error correction, quantum-AI intersections, neuromorphic and other advanced computing). Quantum company funding and quantum stock stories count here because quantum is the subject.
16: The Fun Side. AI humor, funny AI fails, playful demos, viral AI moments, satire and sarcastic commentary, picked mainly because they are entertaining. Serious news with a small joke does not count. Crypto "meme coins" and non-AI memes do not count.
